status: frozen before any tranche-4 outcome value was read by the model developer
context_of_use: U1 initial-state prediction of a new study's control-group mean intraocular pressure (fraction of its preoperative IOP) after a glaucoma procedure in human eyes, from procedure, sub-procedure (device or technique read from the arm's description), series kind, number of eyes and the preoperative IOP only
U2 causal forecasting of each human group mean's next follow-up (control and treated groups) from its own earlier follow-ups, with calibrated intervals
U3 landmark forecasting of every later follow-up of each human group mean from its first postoperative measurement only
not_claimed: biological mechanism validation (aqueous production and outflow are not modelled)
non-human species (one rabbit and one dog training study cannot fit a species population; the four rabbit series of tranche 4 are reported per series only)
treatment-effect prediction (treated groups use the control prior of their context)
that the keyword rules identify every device or technique correctly (an arm matching no rule gets the sub-procedure 'other')
surgical success or failure, hypotony or spike events, medication-adjusted pressure, tonometer equivalence, clinical decision use

model.kinetics: as models 1.1.0 and 1.2.0: ln f(t) = ell + e r(t) + s q(t), r = exp(-(t - t1)/tau), q = exp(-(t - t1)/7 days), t1 = 1 day, t in months, f = IOP / preoperative IOP; ell = context level + b ln(IOP0 / 20 mmHg); each procedure arm of a study has its own study effect
model.hierarchy: species -> procedure -> sub-procedure: contexts species/<sub-procedure>/<procedure> from the declared keyword rules of eye_iop_data_1_3 (the arm's group description and name first, the record title only when they match nothing; procedures without rules have the sub-procedure 'all'), grouping (treatment, context); a sub-procedure without training studies uses its procedure's mean with the between-sub-procedure variance added, a procedure without training studies the species mean with both variances added
model.noise: as model 1.2.0: model 1.1.0 noise in every likelihood; forecasts add independent noise of variance sigma^2 k exp(-(t - t1)/T), k = 8, T = 1 month
model.computation: generic eye recovery model version 2 (eye_recovery_population2) with harness version 2: exact Gaussian mixtures over an 80-point tau grid 0.01..120 months, noise levels, Student-t nodes and robust components; point forecast = predictive median

methods.reference: frozen model 1.2.0 (candidate d0 = iop_population_1_2 c1 with its series), primary population_assimilation (Gaussian) for U2/U3 and population_initial_state for U1, trained on the same records and scored in the same run
methods.secondary: the other population variants, weak_prior, analog_knn (k=5), pooled_curve_ratio, last_two_log_linear, reference_to_last_log_linear, baseline_level, persistence
methods.selection_rule: declared in the development log: lowest pooled group-mean next-observation RMSE among the five population variants with group-mean coverage inside both H1 windows; ties within 0.05 pp to the Gaussian variant

training: the 229 record studies of tranches 1-3 (47 development, 25 consumed by the 1.0.0 test, 74 by the 1.1.0 test and 83 by the 1.2.0 test; listed as development by the tranche-4 reservation); controls with a preoperative IOP fit the population, all series give noise and analog-library inputs; for each sealed study the training studies linked to it by the author-overlap rule are removed from its training set

sealed_test.reserved_by: experiments/data/iop-glaucoma-surgery-2026-10-28/tranche-4/split-reservation-1.0.0.json (94 admitted tranche-4 articles; tranche 4 was reserved for this test before triage)
sealed_test.custodians: eight sub-agents (C1-C8) extracted the sealed records and reported only structure and hashes; every record rebuilds byte for byte
sealed_test.structure_seen_before_freeze: 79 records, 222 series (141 group means, 81 single eyes; 194 control, 28 treated); contexts angle MIGS 82, tube 46, cyclodestruction 42, trabeculectomy 27, cataract 6, subconjunctival MIGS 6, non-penetrating 5, other 4, rabbit trabeculectomy 4; references medicated 181, unmedicated 11, unstated 30; tonometers Goldmann 156, unstated 49, rebound 6, non-contact 5, other 4, Tono-Pen 2; licences 34 public, 45 private; 15 studies excluded by the custodians; no IOP value (.peykar/verify_iop_tranche4_custody.py)
sealed_test.known_exposure: the developer earlier saw the IOP medians of one table of PMC11852638; triage excluded it (medians only)

criteria.per_series: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp (forecasts: AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence)
criteria.unit: percentage points of each series' preoperative IOP
criteria.tested_subset: human group means (U2, U3) and human control group means (U1); the publisher removes every non-human series before H1-H5 and recomputes the summary from the remaining entries
criteria.H1_calibration: pooled primary next-observation coverage over group means: 80% interval within [0.70,0.90] AND 90% within [0.80,0.97]
criteria.H2_accuracy: pooled group-mean next-observation RMSE of the primary lower than each of persistence, last_two_log_linear, pooled_curve_ratio and analog_knn over common targets
criteria.H3_landmark: pooled group-mean landmark RMSE of the primary lower than each of persistence, pooled_curve_ratio and analog_knn over common targets
criteria.H4_initial_state: pooled RMSE of population_initial_state over control group means lower than pooled_training_curve
criteria.H5_versus_1_2: against the frozen model 1.2.0 (d0) trained on the same records, over common human group-mean targets: the pooled landmark RMSE (U3) AND the pooled initial-state RMSE (U1, control group means) of 1.3 each lower than 1.2.0's, AND the pooled next-observation RMSE (U2) of 1.3 at most 0.05 pp higher than 1.2.0's
criteria.reported_not_tested: single eyes, non-human series, all-series pooled values, treated groups, per-context and per-sub-procedure results, landmark and initial-state coverage, first-month coverage against 1.2.0
criteria.all_points: every sealed series/target is scored; none removed; thresholds unchanged after unsealing
criteria.publication: studies whose licence does not permit republishing values keep only per-series metrics and an allow-list of initial-state fields

publication_operator: uv run --frozen python scripts/publish_iop_population_1_3.py --sealed --report <dir>/report.json --reference <dir>/reference-d0-report.json --output <new public dir>
